description: This file defines the FFmpegCaptureService class for capturing PCM16 audio using FFmpeg, intended for streaming to OpenAI's Realtime API. It includes methods for starting/stopping capture, handling FFmpeg process events, and calculating audio energy levels.

classes.name: FFmpegCaptureService
classes.description: A class that manages FFmpeg process to capture PCM16 audio from microphone devices, emitting audio data and energy levels for real-time processing.

methods.name: calculateFrameEnergy
methods.description: Calculates normalized RMS energy of a PCM16 audio frame.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins audio capture, spawning FFmpeg process, and emitting 'audioData' and 'audioEnergy' events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops audio capture and terminates FFmpeg process gracefully.

methods.name: getCaptureDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration in milliseconds since capture started.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Returns whether audio capture is currently active.

methods.name: buildFFmpegArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for FFmpeg based on platform and device.

methods.name: getPlatformInputArgs
methods.description: Provides platform-specific FFmpeg input device arguments.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up FFmpeg process and resets capture state.
